from pyspark.sql.functions import *
from pyspark.sql.types import *

storage_account = "ecomedevstorage"
container_name = "staging"
file_path = "customers_final.csv"

from pyspark.sql.functions import col, trim, initcap, lower, when, to_date
adls_path = f"abfss://{container_name}@{storage_account}.dfs.core.windows.net/{file_path}"

# Reading the dataset
df = spark.read.load(
    adls_path,
    format="csv",
    header=True,
    inferSchema=True
)
df = df.dropDuplicates()

cleaned_df = (
    df
    .withColumn("customer_id", trim(col("customer_id")))
    .withColumn("first_name", initcap(trim(col("first_name"))))
    .withColumn("last_name", initcap(trim(col("last_name"))))
    .withColumn("email", lower(trim(col("email"))))
    .withColumn("city", initcap(trim(col("city"))))
    .withColumn("customer_segment", initcap(trim(col("customer_segment"))))

from pyspark.sql.functions import col, trim, lower, to_timestamp, when

cleaned_df = (
    cleaned_df
    .withColumn("age", col("age").cast("int"))
    .withColumn("signup_date", to_timestamp(col("signup_date")))
    .withColumn("annual_income", col("annual_income").cast("decimal(18,2)"))
    .withColumn("total_spend", col("total_spend").cast("decimal(18,2)"))
    .withColumn("total_orders", col("total_orders").cast("int"))
    .withColumn(
        "is_active",
        when(lower(trim(col("is_active"))) == "true", True)
        .when(lower(trim(col("is_active"))) == "false", False)
        .otherwise(None)
    )

from com.microsoft.spark.sqlanalytics.Constants import Constants

sql_server = "ecom-synapse.sql.azuresynapse.net"

temp_folder = (
    f"abfss://{container_name}@{storage_account}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "staging/sql_temp"
)

(
    cleaned_df.write
    .option(Constants.SERVER, sql_server)
    .option(Constants.TEMP_FOLDER, temp_folder)
    .mode("overwrite")
    .synapsesql("sqlpool.dbo.stg_customer_cleaned")
)

print("Data successfully written to Dedicated SQL Pool!")


mssparkutils.notebook.exit("SUCCESS")
